title: BUGFIX — QC clip_understandable always fails for reaction and listicle templates
rationale: checkClipUnderstandable required segment names 'context', 'insight', 'commentary' — but reaction template uses 'reaction'+'insight'+'cta' and listicle uses 'point'+'point'+'point'+'cta'. Both templates (50% of all videos) always failed this QC gate. Fix: make check template-aware using bundle.template field. Reaction: accept 'reaction' segment as context+commentary substitute. Listicle: require >= 2 substantive 'point' segments.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-qc/index.ts: make checkClipUnderstandable template-aware. Reaction template: check for 'reaction' + 'insight' segments. Listicle: check for >= 2 'point' segments. Standard (default): existing context+insight+commentary check.
